macros.name: hlbox
macros.doc: The \hlbox{text} command renders inline text in a highlighted rounded box with a monospaced (ttfamily) font, which is useful for keywords, technologies, or skills.

macros.name: ressep
macros.doc: The \ressep command separates the experience/event within a section.

macros.name: restitle
macros.doc: The \restitle command helps user to print the title of the resume, which contains key information such as name, location, email, phone, and Linkedin ID.

envs.name: ressection
envs.doc: The ressection environment helps users set the sections (e.g., Education, Experience, Certifications, etc.) of the resume.
